2026-05-07 (post-launch, post-housekeeping) — Reverie v1.0.0 stable is live, repo+store have been audited and swept.

SESSION ARC (after launch session):
1. .mcp.json swap rvr-beta → rvr (commit 4b3555d, on origin/main).
2. Tag cleanup: 22 dead tags deleted from origin + local (debug, beta, rc, typos).
3. GitHub release set pruned in parallel (external process); only v1.0.0 + v1.4–7 remain as Releases.
4. Issue #50 ("npx codexcli") and #47 ("ccli diff") retitled to Reverie/rvr naming, bodies rebranded.
5. Reverie + docs audit pass: 18 findings, all remediated.
   - Critical: deps.esbuild deleted (esbuild dropped in commit-phase); project.refused deleted (corrupted, value was "v"); .reverie/_README.md rebranded; context.devWorkflow corrected (rvr-beta version, .mcp.json target, dropped broken project.storeResidueC ref).
   - State drift: project.inFlight refreshed; context.next_session (this entry) rewritten; project.bunMigrationScope reframed (binary swap shipped, test runner still v1.1+); project.bunValidate closed out as historical record; project.releasePlan replaced with launch retrospective.
   - Rebrand residue: project.commercialContext, project.v115Hints, project.v112, context.execInterpolation cleaned.
   - Style: arch.cli line-ref dropped; arch.llmInstructions rewritten to match actual command shape; docs/schema-guide.md grammar fixed (4× "a the").
   - Kept-as-historical: docs/dogfooding-real-usage.md "the codex" prose (the doc records codex-era work and uses codex_* tool names throughout — rebranding only the prose noun creates voice inconsistency).

NEXT SESSION — STILL POST-LAUNCH MODE:
1. Phase 4 commercial: SeaBear product page (seabear.dev/reverie), consulting tier/pricing, inquiry response template, Reverie for Teams landing.
2. Phase 5 launch comms: blog post (bicameral story + codexCLI → Reverie rebrand narrative), Dogfooding Part Three, GitHub-inbound outreach.
3. Visual identity: logo/wordmark, color palette, marketing site.
4. Engineering housekeeping carry-overs: short-flag audit (context.shortFlagAudit); legacy ccli.rb/ccli-beta.rb cleanup in homebrew-reverie tap; verify `rvr init` template emits the new Reverie-branded _README.md (this repo's copy was hand-fixed but the binary template wasn't re-checked).

DON'T (next bootstrap):
- Re-derive any of the rebrand or Bun work (all shipped).
- Re-do the Reverie/docs audit (just done; sweep is fresh).
- Re-do tag/release cleanup (done).
- Run v1.0.0-beta.2 binary (broken, superseded).

USER STATE: Productive housekeeping session immediately following the launch session. Tag/release cleanup, docs audit, Reverie store audit all completed. Repo is in clean post-launch state with non-engineering work the only thing remaining.
